why: I checked the verifier's PASS/FAIL conditions against each expect line. Check 2 is fine: a README mention of --tsv that says what the flag does matches "documents --tsv". Check 1 is not. Its PASS requires "both commands exit 0 every time", and its FAIL triggers when "either command exits non-zero". Expect line 1 only asks that --tsv read tab input on stdin and print the same JSON array as the plain command. It says nothing about exit status. Check 1 also requires a set output shape, "a JSON array of objects keyed by the header row", with a literal example. The words only require the --tsv output to match whatever the plain CSV command prints, not that it has a given structure. Both requirements are stricter than the expect line and belong under Advisory, not in PASS/FAIL.
